concerns.text: FR-002 requires side‑by‑side histograms of the sum versus component delays, but no task creates or verifies histogram image files (e.g., PNGs).
FR-007 mandates that all findings be framed as ‘associational only’; there is no task that inserts this disclaimer into the final report or documentation.
FR-013 defines a pass/fail condition that at least three models must converge with finite parameters, yet no task asserts or tests this condition after model fitting.
SC-002 requires at least three distinct parametric models to yield finite AIC/BIC scores, but no task validates or enforces this requirement.
SC-005 demands the entire analysis complete within 3600 seconds, while the plan and FR‑008 allow up to 6 hours, creating a contradictory constraint and no task explicitly targets the 3600 s limit.
SC-008 expects side‑by‑side histograms for the sum vs. component distributions; tasks only produce CSVs and a KS test (T018, T024) but no histogram generation task.
SC-008 also expects the KS test result to be reported; while T024 produces a KS test JSON, the histogram visual artefacts are missing.
SC-008’s histogram requirement is not covered by any task.
